why: The first good rains start the season. Every week you wait, the crop has less time to grow.
Fertilizer feeds the crop twice: once to start it, once when it grows fast.
Hybrid seed gives more in a good season, but you must buy new seed each year.
Healthy soil holds water and helps the crop use fertilizer.
A legume row gives a second harvest and can feed the soil for next season.
Dry spells are common. Water kept in the soil can save the harvest.
Weevils and damp can destroy a good harvest after it leaves the field.
